about_short_description.short_description: Miter provides human capital management, field operations, and expense management platform for the construction industry.

product.name: Human Capital Management (HCM)
product.description: A platform that manages hiring, payroll, employee development, benefits, and learning for construction contractors.

product.name: Field Operations
product.description: A system for managing time tracking, production, equipment, photos, and scheduling on construction job sites.

product.name: Expense Management
product.description: A solution to centralize and manage expenses, per diems, reimbursements, and corporate cards alongside payroll and time tracking.

product.name: Payroll
product.description: A construction-specific payroll platform that automates multi-state tax calculations, union and certified payroll compliance, and detailed labor costing.

product.name: Job Costing
product.description: A real-time job costing platform that tracks direct and indirect labor costs, equipment, and materials to provide accurate project cost insights.

product.name: Compliance
product.description: A labor compliance platform that automates certified payroll reporting, union fringe calculations, prevailing wage management, and multi-state labor law adherence.
